• A User can specify the remaining lifespan of existing Assets (either through a % or year value input)

• A User can apply either a default Renewal Frequencies or a bespoke Renewal Frequency to any Asset Renewal activity within the estimate – this will not change the default Asset Renewal Frequency stored in the software library

• The Assets included within the estimate will be renewed when their age is equal to the Asset Renewal Frequency specified by the User

• A User can review and amend the Asset Renewal Quantity for any year within the assessment period of the Asset Renewal estimate

1230.description: See FR 1191 - Flexibility to use either the Item rate derived from the resource buildup or a contractual item rate which may not have a resource level build up
1230.acceptanceCriteria:
As a user I can use Items which have a full labour, plant, materials Resource build-up, or an Item unit rate (e.g. a contractual Item rate) using only a single ‘Subcontractor’ Resource.
Items can be used from different libraries to produce estimates.

1240.description: As an estimator, I want to make sure that the rate used from the library is correct where contractual rates vary with quantity bandings.   This can be addressed through correct configuration of the item library, where item descriptions identify the quantity band and library rates for that band can be auto-allocated to the item.  Each quantity banding is a separate item within the SDF Schedule of Rates , so a correctly produced SoI will account for quantity bandings.
1240.acceptanceCriteria: An Item library can be configured with Item descriptions that contain quantity bands.

1250.description: See FR 1192 - When there are no Items within the library, allow the estimator to use available resource buildups and create Star Items

1251.description: As an estimator, or estimating manager, I want to be able to identify the "star rates" that have been created for a specific estimate, i.e. that are not in the current item library.  Once star rates are approved and added to the contract and library, they do not need to be identified  as "star rates"
1251.acceptanceCriteria: Items in an estimate can be tagged as "Star Rates", i.e. not part of an original set of Items for the project /  contract.

1260.description:
As an Estimator I need the software to be able to produce a TPE Asset Renewal output at Cost Element level.

Probabilistic estimating / TPE for Long-Term Appraisal cost estimated is not included in the CCET Phase 3 functional requirements. We propose to apply the Acceptance Criteria for FR860 and FR1260 and Feature Design for these functional requirements to NH Long-Term Appraisal cost estimates to provide this coverage.

Please see the following related Functional Requirements:
▪ FR140 (SS Chapter 6, Supplier Forecasting) refers to converting a supplier forecast to a NH range estimate. (This is produced through existing CCET Phase 1 functionality for Major Projects, FR860 for Routine O&M and FR1260 for Asset Renewals.)
▪ FR430 (SRS Chapter 8, Reporting) refers to comparison reports of the current estimate vs. the last approved estimate / other previous estimates for a project to include showing the range of an estimate where this is in place
▪ CCET Phase 1 FR30 (Delivered)
▪ CCET Phase 1 FR10 (Delivered)
▪ CCET Phase 1 FR21 (Partially Delivered – remaining items are PDF and CDF charts covered in FR860 and FR1260 acceptance criteria)
▪CCET Phase 2 FRs bullet point 6, “Configure and upload a ‘baseline’ carbon resource library… in three-point estimating format….. – addressed by SRS Chapter 11, Data Libraries, FR410, Acceptance Criterion 8 inter alia.
1260.acceptanceCriteria: NH Estimators can enter a minimum and maximum estimated cost for a cost element either side of the CCET calculated value for an Asset Renewals scheme's estimated cost (which forms the most-likely input value of the three-point estimate for the cost element). The three-point estimates for each cost element are input at the estimate base date, prior to inflation.

1270.description:
As an Estimator I need the software to apply risk using one of two methods:
1) Top down risk % allowance, based upon a risk matrix method (e.g. level of scheme design info available and scheme technical complexity) which is then applied at Section level
2) Import of a risk register, which is then applied at Section level



See 1270 - Risk - Top down estimating approach
1270.acceptanceCriteria: As an estimator, risk can be applied at Section level using the top-down method or with an imported risk register.

1280.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Automatic top-down calculation of allowances based on calculation the  Project Carbon Risk / Opportunity / Uncertainty allowance x (Base Carbon Estimate/Base Cost Estimate) - as per FR1090

1290.description: See 1270 - Validation questions to provide a risk percentage and allow an estimator to assign Section-level Risk
1290.acceptanceCriteria: As an estimator, I want to assign risk to a cost or carbon estimate at section level

1300.description: As an Estimator I require the software to store and apply relevant spend profiles (based on scheme characteristics, type etc.) to the forecast costs across each of the 3D stages.
1300.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET has an administrator-controlled library of default expenditure profiles for Asset Renewals estimates

1310.description: See 1190-1193 - User-friendly way to select the time and period the works will be completed (this would need to consider Region/Contractor/Time/Season)
1310.acceptanceCriteria:
As an estimator, I can select apply rates from a user selected library in a user-friendly way based on 
• The region, 
• Supplier lot/sub-lots, 
• Specific supplier 
• Specific delivery/commercial details such as time of day, day of week and seasons.

1320.description: There may be multiple Asset Renewal cost estimates for any scheme (i.e. multiple options). The Estimator should be able to update any previous Asset Renewal cost estimate to reflect the latest scheme details
1320.acceptanceCriteria:
As an estimator, I can create a copy of a completed estimate or revision and modify the estimate. 

As an estimator I can change the following:
• Scope - items of work and/or quantities
• Resources
• Schedule
• Risk
• Expenditure profile
• Inflation

1330.description: Compare Estimated Carbon Impact with Carbon Reduction Targets at Scheme, Programme and Portfolio levels
1330.acceptanceCriteria:
• An authorised user can enter a Carbon Reduction Target (CAP) for a project in the software
• A user can see a report or dashboard that compares the Carbon Reduction Target(CAP) with an estimate for the project
• I should also be able to see a reports showing the aggregated latest estimate data versus the aggregated carbon reduction targets at Programme or Portfolio Level
• The data is based on approved estimates only and informed by either the preferred estimates or reference estimates
• As a user I can see how a forecast submitted by a Project User compares to the Carbon Reduction Target (CAP) for that project

1340.description: Configure PAS2080 requirements to align with the RICS 2nd edition
1340.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET carbon libraries hold data at the granularity of PAS 2080 modules / sub-modules set out in reference document "W.16 - Modules for Whole Life Carbon and alignment to latest RICS guidance.xls" provided by Circular Ecology

1350.description: As an Estimator I can filter cost and carbon estimates for any Asset Renewal cost estimate by Portfolio, Programme, Scheme, Area, Region and EIN
1350.acceptanceCriteria: As an Estimator I can browse or search in the CCET for any cost and carbon estimate for Asset Renewal by Portfolio, Programme, Scheme, Area, Region and EIN.

1360.description: As an Estimator I need the software to have the capability to tag all activities within the estimate as either B4 or B5,  for reporting purposes as per PAS 2080 requirements.
1360.acceptanceCriteria:
As an Estimator I can estimate B4 and B5 separately for purposes of reporting carbon as per PAS2080 requirements.

The Items for an Asset Renewals estimate in the CCET can be tagged as PAS 2080 module B4 or B5.

1370.description: See FR 670 - Ability to overwrite the calculated top-down carbon risk allowance
1370.acceptanceCriteria: An Estimator can enter top-down Cost and Carbon Risk allowances to a Section in an Estimate, instead of importing a risk register or automatically-calculated risk allowances (see SRS Chapter 1 for details of the automatic calculation of top-down risk allowances).

1380.description: As an estimator, I want the ability to apply a cost to carbon factor for a specific resource group to a resource that does not have a carbon emission factor in the library or an item / composite item that does not have a first-principles build-up and therefore does not have a carbon emission factor in a library.  The cost to carbon factors should be stored in a dedicated library.
1380.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET stores cost-to-carbon factors in an administrator-controlled library or libraries for application to each lifecycle costing stage.

1390.description: See FRs 570, 580, 670 - Calculate Carbon Risk and Uncertainty Allowance at the Cost Header (Cost Element) level using the Cost to Carbon Intensity Factor
1390.acceptanceCriteria:
As a user, CCET needs to automatically generate a cost to carbon intensity factor for risk and uncertainty across PAS2080 modules, derived from the base estimates of cost and carbon.

These cost to carbon intensity factors for risk and uncertainty can be applied in CCET at Section cost element level to generate carbon risk/uncertainty allowance in Carbon estimates.

1400.description: See FRs 570, 580, 670 - Produce a Carbon Risk and Opportunity Allowance at the Project, Programme and Portfolio levels
1400.acceptanceCriteria:
Please also refer to acceptance criteria for FR570, FR580 and FR670 for further details.

As a user I can produce carbon risk and opportunity allowances at the following levels

•  Project level
•  Programme level
•  Portfolio level

1410.description: See FR 1120 - View the carbon expenditure profile over time by WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) and by Resource
1410.acceptanceCriteria: As an estimator I can view the expenditure profile over time by WBS and by Resource.

1420.description:
For MP OMR estimate, administrative screens to be produced to allow configuration as per the OMR model issued to be set, these include
Software to allow selection of user-configurable assessment period, e.g. 60 or 120 years.
Software to allow asset renewal frequencies over assessment period to be set for various new assets.
Software to allow setting of residual life for various existing assets on Opening to traffic based on either user input per asset or default set at x%. And then setting frequencies similar to new assets for renewed existing assets based on first renewal after opening to traffic.

1430.description: Produce a Do-Something case estimate - with the ability to identify New, Renewed, Removed, Unchanged assets for MP and Asset renewals schemes' TOTEX
1430.acceptanceCriteria:
As an NH Estimator, I can populate the “Scenario” field in whole lifecycle estimate to denote that the estimate is for a “With Scheme” (Do-Something) or a “Without Scheme” scenario.

As an NH Estimator, I can produce a whole lifecycle cost and carbon estimate for a specific scenario and project.

Please see SRS Chapter 2, Long Term Appraisal for TOTEX estimates for “With Scheme” and “Without Scheme” scenarios.

1440.description: As an estimator, I want the ability to have a consolidated TOTEX estimate for an MP Enhancement scheme. This will show the MP Capex, it's impact on M&R and its impact on Asset Renewals within a single TOTEX estimate and report.
1440.acceptanceCriteria:
• A User can produce a consolidated TOTEX estimate for a scheme, which comprise CAPEX, O&M and Asset Renewal estimates

• A User can select the TOTEX assessment period up to 200-years

1450.description: As an estimator, I want the ability to have a consolidated TOTEX estimate for an Asset Renewals scheme. This will show the AR Capex, it's impact on M&R and it's impact on Asset Renewals within a single TOTEX estimate and report.

1460.description: Software to be configured to allow both detailed bottom up TOTEX estimates to be produced (both MP and AR) in future as well as top-down TOTEX estimates, using composite rates for both M&R and Asset Renewals works.
1460.acceptanceCriteria: The Items within the CCET Item libraries are configurable by an administrator.

1470.description: See FR 1450 - Setup a "Long term AR" Item Library with "all in rates" (Periodic Items) with the internal Resource buildup and carbon, but without the variables (uplifts)
1470.acceptanceCriteria: The Items within the CCET Item libraries are configurable by an administrator.

1480.description: See FR 1450 - Assumed renewal periods need to apply to the spend profile levels
1480.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET can store a library of asset renewal frequencies for long-term appraisal estimates.

1490.description: Generate Estimate Reports for each of the following - Do-Minimum, Do-Something, Incremental difference
1490.acceptanceCriteria:
• For long-term appraisal TotEx estimates, A user can assign a configurable ‘scenario’ tag to an estimate
• A user can generate estimate reports for a scenario
• A user can generate reports of the incremental difference between two like-for-like estimates for different scenarios for the same scheme

1500.description: TOTEX reporting - will require the whole life cycle reporting of the Cost and Carbon stage A-C
1500.acceptanceCriteria:
• A user can generate a TotEx carbon report showing the estimated carbon for each module within PAS 2080 Stages A, B and C
• A user can generate a summary report that provides sub-totals by PAS 2080 Stage
• The reports can be generated on screen in the software carbon module
• The reports can be exported to PDF and Excel format.

1510.description: TOTEX reporting adhering to the ICMS3 standard
1510.acceptanceCriteria:
• A user can generate a report showing estimated carbon emissions for each PAS 2080 module, by each ICMS category
• A user can generate a report showing total annual operational energy usage for module B6 in KWh/yr
• A user can generate a report showing total estimated operational water consumption for module B7 in litres

1520.description: Use a decarbonisation deflation profile against different Cost element/resource groupings. This is so that the user can forecast the decarbonisation of an asset for e.g. 2030, 2040, 2050. (TBC, depending on definition of process)
1520.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains carbon deflation profile in an administrator-controlled library with the profile stored as an index value.

1530.description: Use a decarbonisation deflation profile against different Cost element. This is so that the user can forecast the decarbonisation of an asset for e.g. 2030, 2040, 2050. Software to be configured to allow carbon inflation calculations to be applied initially set at 0%
1530.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains carbon deflation profile in a library with the profile stored as an index value.

1540.description:
NH User - Have the ability to Browse/Find an Forecast from top-level drill down Portfolio > Programme > Scheme > Estimates with Option description and associated EIN reference. Ability to navigate to the Forecast from this window. I should also be able to Search the Browser with Search feature by Description or MP Number etc..
Supply Chain User - As NH User but limited to supplier's allocated schemes only
1540.acceptanceCriteria: An NH Estimator can select a project in the 'Forecast Browser' and see all forecasts for that project as long as the user has permissions to access that project. NH Estimator / NH estimating manager / HoCE can have access to all project estimates, IFT revisions for all portfolio and programmes under the Enterprise.

1550.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - When updating a Revision of my Forecast I want to be able to add Resources from the NH Resource Library (Code & Description only - No Rate) into my Items and add my own rate. If a Resource does not exist in the NH Resource Library, I want to be able to collect these and make a request to an NH Administrator to add these into the Resource Library for use in the Forecast. - This process would sit outside of the software - e.g. Excel template the supplier completes and formally submits to NH for NH to add to library if approved.
1550.acceptanceCriteria:
CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add resources to an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding resources only from the assigned Resource Library. This setting can be applied by CCET administrator in IFT modules to all IFT revision settings or to a specific Project.
A Project User when above settings allow, can when producing an IFT revision and/or revisions
• add resources from the CCET library(code and description only, without a rate) to their items and apply their own rates.
• A Project User can add resources from the assigned resource library or libraries (i.e. to which they have permission for the project) to the Items in their forecast and enter a new rate for the resource
• where a required resource isn’t available in the CCET Library, they can request an NH Administrator to add them in CCET library before using the new section/cost element/item/resource. The request and approval process to add to CCET library would take place outside the software.
• When producing a forecast / forecasts, a Project User, when above settings allow, can request an NH Administrator to add a Resource to a Resource Library that the Project User has permission to access before using the new resource. The request and approval process to add the Resource to this library would take place outside the software.

1560.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I will need to be able to create a new Revision from a previous Revision and have some form of Revision referencing auto-populate. Creating a new Revision should be simple, such as a 'Create New Revision' button feature or similar.
1560.acceptanceCriteria: A NH Estimator or Project User can select a menu item "generate new revision" in an existing forecast and create a new forecast.

1570.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want the ability to edit and change the carbon emissions factors pre-populated in the Forecast by the "Baseline" scheme and carbon library, at Resource level to a bespoke value to suit my estimate.
1570.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET user preparing a forecast(called as Project User), can edit the carbon emissions factors of a resource in the forecast for each applicable PAS 2080 module.

A Project User preparing a forecast can edit the carbon emissions factors of a resource in the forecast for each applicable PAS 2080 module.

For each IFT revision and/or revisions, Project User uses Project User Specific Library (PUSL) (this is A user specific cost and carbon library for applicable project) to produce forecast revision/ revisions.

Project Users can add Resources marked as "unassured" to the Project Specific Library with unassured carbon values for each Resource.

Once approved through an assurance process outside CCET, these Resources are updated to "assured" status within the Project Specific Library.

When creating forecasts, Project Users can copy or drag low-carbon assured resources from the Dynamic Library of Low Carbon Products (DLLCP) to the Project Specific Library (PSL) for use in Forecasts

An Administrator can copy or drag low-carbon assured resources from the PSL to the DLLCP, making them available for other projects and keeping the DLLCP up to date with the lowest carbon resources
Project Users can add STAR ITEMS marked as "unassured" to the Project User Specific library. Once approved through an assurance process outside CCET, these items are updated to "assured" status within the Project User Specific library.
When creating IFT revisions, Project Users can:
• Copy or drag low-carbon assured resources from the Dynamic Library of Low Carbon Products (DLLCP) to the Project User-Specific Library (PUSL) for use IFT revision and /or revisions.
• Copy or drag low-carbon assured resources from the PUSL to the DLLCP, making them available for other projects and keeping the DLLCP up to date with the lowest carbon resources.

1580.description: As a Project User, I want to be able to export the provided Forecast (cost and carbon) to MS Excel so that I can make changes to quantities, rates, carbon factors, expenditure profile, inflation profile, risk register and then upload these changes in bulk from MS Excel to the software for Forecast submission.
1580.acceptanceCriteria:
A Project User, to which a forecast has been assigned, can export the following to MS Excel for the forecast (baseline or IFT/Forecast other) covering all Sections, Cost Elements and Items in the forecast's 'base estimate’ /IFT(Forecast): 
- Section codes, Section Description and Section Cost (if Section cost data is visible) 
- Cost Element codes, Cost Element Description and Cost Element Costs (if Cost Element cost data is visible) 
- the Item codes, Item descriptions, Item quantities, Item units, Item cost rates and item costs (if rate / cost data is visible) 
- the forecast Resources by Item (including Resource codes, Resource descriptions, Resource quantities, Resource units, Resource cost rates and Resource costs (only if rate / cost data is visible) with carbon emissions per carbon module for each resource and Item totals per module

1590.description: As an NH reviewer of the Forecast, I want the ability to ensure that Project Users use only the item library and resource library descriptions and codes (they can change rates) so that the libraries do not get cluttered with "similar but different" items / resources. Therefore I want the system to validate Forecast submissions vs. the existing item and resource libraries and any non-conformances are declined. These can be added to the library through a business process (see FR 1550).
1590.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add items to a forecast version an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding items only from the assigned section/cost element/Item/resource Library.
A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add items to a forecast by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding items only from the assigned Item Library. A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add Resources to a forecast by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding Resources only from the assigned Resource Library.
These settings can be applied to a specific Project or across IFT templates for project estimate types in FR10. These settings can be applied to specific projects or to all projects so that they apply to all forecasts across the CCET.
Segments are replicated from base estimates and only after changing the base estimate the IFT version can be replicated for the required segmentation. CCET checks Project Users’ IFT revision submission and/or submissions against the CCET library (sections, cost elements, items, and resources) and the base estimate segmentation. Any non-conformances are rejected. If needed, an Estimator can re-segment the base estimate and update the IFT template, accordingly, allowing the Project User to produce IFT revision/forecast using the revised segmentation.

A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add resources to an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding resources only from the assigned Resource Library. This setting can be applied to a specific Project.

1600.description: Use specific dates over which to profile the expenditure and assign a continuous profile
1600.acceptanceCriteria:
Project user preparing a forecast can enter specific start and finish dates for the Project's milestones. These input dates set the timeline for profiling expenditure.

A Project user preparing a forecast can enter specific start and finish dates for the Project's milestones. These input dates set the timeline for profiling expenditure.

1610.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to use specific dates over which to profile the expenditure and assign a continuous profile, as long as these dates match with the Project User's entered dates for the set milestones, e.g. by PCF Stage Dates, 3D Stage Dates, O&M Assessment Period etc… It will not give full freedom to the user as any non-conformity to the BES system will not allow migration back from the Forecast to BES.
1610.acceptanceCriteria:
For each cost element within a forecast, the expenditure profile runs between a start and finish date for the cost element that exactly matches the project milestones' start and finish dates entered by a Project User.

CCET include IFT/forecast build for various forecast types in FR10 that allows Project users to input dates and / or expenditure profile or import dates and / or expenditure profile via excel.
The Project User specific dates (PCF stage, 3D stages, O&M assessment periods, LTA assessment periods) gets applied to default expenditure profiles from library to produce an expenditure profile at cost element and / or Section level. Where full expenditure profile is available rather than relying on default profiles, these can be imported in CCET IFT to produce the expenditure profile.
The expenditure profile by either or both of the above approaches can be entered and produced by FY Quarters or Months (via a toggle) against section/ Cost Element levels in IFT/forecast template.

1620.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to be able to enter my spend profile by FY Quarters or Months (via a toggle) against the defined Cost Elements.
1620.acceptanceCriteria:
When preparing a forecast, a Project User can see profiled expenditure per month, per quarter or per annum by changing a setting to show costs by these time periods.

When preparing a forecast, a Project User can see profiled expenditure per month, per quarter or per annum by changing a setting to show costs by these time periods.

1630.description: NH User - I want to be able to see one Revision alongside another Revision for the same scheme and compare the build up with tracked changes. Supply Chain User - As NH User but limited to supplier's allocated schemes only
1630.acceptanceCriteria: A CCET User can produce a comparison report showing side-by-side comparison of two selected forecasts (either baseline forecast and revision or two other revisions).

1640.description: See FR 1590 - On each Forecast screen, add a toggle to view cost and carbon data or both for the baseline and live Forecast
1640.acceptanceCriteria: A CCET User Project User can select whether to view carbon data alongside cost data or only cost data live when working in / IFT revision / forecast viewing a forecast for baseline or IFT revision / forecast

1650.description: NH User &Supply Chain User - On each Forecast screen, add a toggle to view cost and carbon data or both for the baseline and latest / any Forecast Revision
1650.acceptanceCriteria: A CCET Project User and Estimator can select whether to view carbon data alongside cost data when working in / IFT revision / forecast viewing a forecast for baseline or latest or any IFT revision / forecast

1660.description: NH User - At a summary level, I want to be able to compare the "Baseline" total cost and carbon against the Supplier's forecast at Scheme Level > Region > Programme > Portfolio Default is to use the latest Revision(s) versus the Baseline(s), but the user is able to select an alternate supplier Revision if required. Supply Chain User - As NH User but limited to supplier's allocated schemes only
1660.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET User can produce a comparison report showing side-by-side comparison of two selected forecasts (either baseline forecast and revision or two other revisions).
In CCET a NH User (Estimator / IFT Reviewer/ Estimating manager / HOCE) can compare the "Baseline" total cost and carbon against IFT revision forecast at Project Level > Region > Programme > Portfolio in a project along with tracked changes for any project in CCET. Comparison uses the latest Revision(s) versus the Baseline(s) as default, but the user is able to select any alternate project IFT Revision if required. The comparison is seen of on IFT screens and can be exported as excel and PDF reports from CCET.

The above is required by each Life cycle stage and Whole Life cycle for cost and carbon for all estimate types in FR10.
A CCET User can only produce reports for those projects that the user has permissions to access.
In CCET IFT revision screen Project User (Supply Chain User) can compare the "Baseline" total cost and carbon against IFT revision forecast at Project Level > Region > Programme > Portfolio in a project along with tracked changes only for their allocated/assigned project along with tracked changes. The comparison is seen of on IFT screens and can be exported as excel and PDF reports from CCET.

The above is required by each Life cycle stage and Whole Life cycle for cost and carbon for all estimate types in FR10.

1670.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to be able to track changes made in the latest Revision against the immediate Forecast Revision it preceded. This is to allow a user/reviewer to see where alterations have been made.
1670.acceptanceCriteria:
In CCET a NH User (Estimator / IFT Reviewer/ Estimating manager / HOCE) for any project can track changes in the latest IFT revision alongside immediate IFT revision forecast that preceded it including baseline estimate. The comparison shows tracked change comments in comparison. This allows NH users/reviewers to see what and when changes have happened on projects.

In CCET a Project User only for the assigned / allocated project can track changes in the latest IFT revision alongside immediate IFT revision forecast that preceded it including baseline estimate. The comparison shows tracked change comments in comparison. This allows Project User to see what and when changes have happened on projects.

The above comparison report for IFT revision FR10 estimate shows side-by-side comparison of, but not limited to:
• Total forecast Project costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Total forecast Section costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Total forecast Cost Element costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Item and resources quantities*
• Item cost rates and carbon rates by PAS 20280 modules
• Item costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Resource costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules*
• Fee
• Risk/Opportunity/Uncertainty – cost and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Cost expenditure and carbon profile by PAS 20280 modules
• Inflation
• Portfolio risk – cost and carbon by PAS 20280 modules

The above is required by each Life cycle stage and Whole Life cycle for cost and carbon for all estimate types in FR10.

*Full Resource-by-Item reports to be generated for export to Excel and PDF but may not be practical to show on screen within the CCET Phase 3 scope.

A CCET User can produce a comparison report showing side-by-side comparison of two selected forecasts (including latest revision vs. pervious revision).

1680.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to be able to view the "Baseline" alongside any Revision (including the latest) with the tracked changes made against the "Baseline" in Realtime
1680.acceptanceCriteria:
In CCET a NH User (Estimator / IFT Reviewer/ Estimating manager / HOCE) for any project can see tracked changes between current or any previous IFT revisions alongside baseline estimate along with change comments in real time. The comparison shows tracked change comments in comparison including side-by-side comparison of, but not limited to:
• Total forecast Project costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Total forecast Section costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Total forecast Cost Element costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Item and resources quantities*
• Item cost rates and carbon rates by PAS 20280 modules
• Item costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Resource costs and carbon by PAS 20280 modules*
• Fee
• Risk/Opportunity/Uncertainty – cost and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
• Cost expenditure and carbon profile by PAS 20280 modules
• Inflation
• Portfolio risk – cost and carbon by PAS 20280 modules
The above is required by each Life cycle stage and Whole Life cycle for cost and carbon for all estimate types in FR10.

*Full Resource-by-Item reports to be generated for export to Excel and PDF but may not be practical to show on screen within the CCET Phase 3 scope.
When working in a forecast, A Project User can view a screen that shows, in real-time, the baseline forecast alongside the current forecast and shows the following: 
- Total forecast Project costs and carbon
- Total forecast Section costs and carbon 
- Total forecast Cost Element costs and carbon 
- Item quantities 
- Item cost rates and carbon rates 
- Item costs and carbon

1681.description: NH User - When the user selects a scheme and a "Baseline" estimate, there should be a summary table shown with all the associated revisions, displaying the Cost and Carbon estimate values for the baseline and Forecasts with the percentage Increase or Decrease Supply Chain User - As NH User but limited to supplier's allocated schemes only
1681.acceptanceCriteria: An NH Estimator can select a project in the 'Forecast Browser' and see all forecasts for that project as long as the user has permissions to access that project.

1690.description: Ability to add a segment and associated cost element from a template - FR not needed. Addressed through existing functionality (FR . (Not needed as Forecast PCF0-2 only allows high-level changes and low level changes to a fixed BoQ, plus the ability to add high-level scope - just mandate them to allocate this to a current Cost Element for forecasting purposes. For Forecast PCF3-5 the Supplier data can be exported and imported as long as it aligns to the CESS Cost Elements)
1690.acceptanceCriteria:
Not applicable - "FR not needed“ This functionality required for MP PCF 0 to 2 stage estimates, is part of both Phase 1 and 2 and CCET Phase 3 scope requirements which is to be delivered as part of CCET phase 3.

MP PCF Stage 0 to 2 and MP Stages 3 to 5 – IFT approach and process as per the excel IFTs provided to Benchmark.

1700.description: NH User - I want to be able to approximate cost impact at the top down using the PCF Stage 0-2 Forecast - the user can only change the scope, risk, schedule, schedule of other costs, they cannot edit Items or rates. This allows high-level scope changes to be made quickly based on pre-defined cost estimating relationships between the high-level levers and the associated items. Supply Chain User - Not applicable
1700.acceptanceCriteria: An NH Estimator can amend input variables at Project, Section, and / or Item level that make top-down changes to existing item quantities - subject to calculations for the relationships between input variable and Item quantities being set up in the forecast.

1710.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to see and be able to edit input fields to cover the existing "Change Key Data" worksheet in the MS Excel Forecast.
1710.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET user, to which a forecast is assigned, can amend the following subject to administration settings for their settings:
- VAT % - NRVAT Hybrid % 
- allocation of library Fee percentage for each Section / Cost Element 
- Programme Risk - Portfolio Risk

1720.description: See FR 1690 - Flexibility to add Segments to the Estimate Structure of Sections and Cost elements when working on an Estimate as a Contractor
1720.acceptanceCriteria:
Not applicable - "FR not needed“
If a Project User needs a different segmentation in an IFT revision in CCET,
• The Project User can request the NH Estimator to revise the baseline estimate with the desired segmentation and provide an updated IFT revision in CCET.
• The NH Estimator can create the revised re-segmented baseline estimate as requested and provide the revised IFT revision in CET to the Project User.
The communication process of requesting will take place outside of CCET
Segments in a Forecast are replicated from the NH baseline estimate or duplicated forecast.
Segments in a Forecast can be edited to revise the segmentation, except for the locked baseline Forecast.

1730.description: As a Project User, when completing an Forecast PCF0-2, I want the ability to make changes only to the existing item quantities, schedule milestones, risks. Any bespoke items / items outside the existing bill can be added to the risk Revision register as an "Uncertainty" adjustment.
1730.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add items to an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding items only from the assigned Item Library. This setting can be applied to a specific Project.

A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add resources to an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding resources only from the assigned Resource Library. This setting can be applied to a specific Project.

1750.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - I want to see the "Scope" split in different windows for the Contractor's works and the NH's Schedule of Other Costs (SoOC). This will make it easier to review the NH SoOC and Contractor's scope.
1750.acceptanceCriteria: When preparing or reviewing a forecast, a Project User can see a summary of costs for selected and/or all Sections and cost elements (e.g. 'Schedule of Other Costs' for an MP scheme) alongside the BoQ (schedule of items) so that forecasts costs can be compared with baseline estimates.

1760.description: See FR 1840 - Capture an estimate containing actual costs and actual carbon against the resources within an M&R estimate representing/recording what occurred at a point in time of operations.
1760.acceptanceCriteria:
An Operation and Maintenance forecast contains "planned" and "actual" columns at Item level and above for the following fields for each year of a forecast's assessment period: 
- Item quantity - Item cost (including resources-level data for planned / forecast items) 
- Item carbon (with module split): 
- Cost Element cost 
- Cost Element carbon 
- Section cost 
- Section carbon (with module split)

1770.description: See FR 1840 - M&R Estimates - Ability to update the forecast quantities and estimated carbon for a given time period from the original estimate to actual quantities and actual carbon. Then, re-estimate the quantities for the remaining period.
1770.acceptanceCriteria:
An Operation and Maintenance forecast contains "planned" and "actual" columns at Item/resource level and above for the following fields for each year of a forecast's assessment period: - Item/resource quantity (resources for planned only, not actuals)*; - Item/resource cost (resources for planned only, not actuals)*; - Item carbon (with module split); - Cost Element cost; - Cost Element carbon; - Section cost; - Section carbon (with module split)
*For actuals resource level data(quantity and rates) may not be available however for planned data will be available at resource level.

1780.description: See FR 1840 - M&R Estimates - Ability to update the forecast quantities and estimated costs for a given time period from the original estimate to actual quantities and actual costs. Then, re-estimate the quantities for the remaining period using the library rates.
1780.acceptanceCriteria:
An Operation and Maintenance forecast contains "planned" and "actual" columns at Item level and above for the following fields for each year or month of a forecast's assessment period:
- Item quantity 
- Item cost 
- Item carbon (with module split): 
- Cost Element cost 
- Cost Element carbon
 - Section cost 
- Section carbon (with module split)

A Project User producing a forecast for an Operation and Maintenance project can input actual Item quantities and Item costs in dedicated "actual" columns for each past year or month in the forecast's assessment period.

In an O&M forecast, the data in the "planned" and "actual" columns can be reported to show planned vs. actual totals by year or month and position on screen and in reports.

[Please see FR1770 for related FR and acceptance criteria]

1800.description: Covered by FR 1700 - Stage 0-2 there are no rate changes are to be made in the system.

1810.description: As an NH or Project User for M&R estimates, I want to have revision reporting , so I can update baseline with actuals / reforecasts and compare the changes baseline v Revision (for example, intervention quantities, costs, reforecast quantities, risk allowances). This will be for a rolling period with a c. 60 month period for viewing actual vs. predicted.
1810.acceptanceCriteria:
For an O&M forecast, a CCET User with permissions to access the project can produce a detailed comparison report showing side-by-side comparison of baseline O&M forecast and a revision. The report shall show the following data for baseline vs. revision for each selected year:
- Total forecast Project costs 
- Total forecast Section costs 
- Total forecast Cost Element costs 
- Item Asset quantities 
- Item Intervention frequencies 
- Item cost rates 
- Item costs A CCET user can generate a similar report for carbon forecast data.

1820.description: NH User & Supply Chain User - Cost and Carbon Estimates - As a Project User, I want to be able to view a dashboard / report with the estimated / actual cost and carbon expenditure (driven by resource profiles) over the assessment period.
1820.acceptanceCriteria:
• A user can generate a report or dashboard for an Operation and Maintenance estimate that shows the estimated and actual cost and carbon expenditure over the assessment period
• The estimated and actual cost and carbon expenditure can be shown on the same dashboard
• The estimated and actual cost and carbon expenditure can be shown by month with annual totals
• Cost and carbon expenditure profile reports can be generated by Project Users for scheme forecasts
• The estimated cost and carbon profile in the dashboard are linked to resource profiles used to produce forecast cost and carbon expenditure

1830.description: The system shall assess and report carbon for each PAS 2080 stage and module as set out in subject matter expert Circular Ecology's recommended module breakdown selected from RICS 2nd Edition of Whole Life Carbon Assessment. As an estimator, I want Project Users to input a forecast that follows the structure of NH estimate (for each of the estimate types set out in Scope Table A) at an appropriate level of the WBS
1830.acceptanceCriteria: Forecasts align with the PAS 2080 modules configured in the CCET for each Estimate Type in FR10 for Major Projects, O&M, Renewals and Long Term Appraisal so that NH Estimates and Project Users' forecasts have like-for-like comparison of carbon estimates that comply with the carbon modules defined in NH file "W.16 - Modules for Whole Life Carbon and alignment to latest RICS guidance" prepared by Circular Ecology.

1840.description: Applicable to Maintenance and Response estimates - As a Project User, I want to produce an interim forecast that takes the baseline M&R estimate and updates it incrementally (e.g. monthly or annually) with the actual quantities of interventions carried out, actual costs and then reforecast the intervention levels in remaining years (e.g. year 1 is updated with actuals and years 2-5 are reforecast). As a project user, I want to be able to see easily the impact of my reforecast (compare the baseline and reforecast) so that I am able to reforecast and plan intervention levels to fit with the baseline budget estimate. This approach should be consistent with the interim forecasting functionality for MP and AR.
1840.acceptanceCriteria:
An Operation and Maintenance forecast contains "planned" and "actual" columns at Item level and above for the following fields for each year of a forecast's assessment period: 
- Item quantity
- Frequency and intervention quantity for planned - Item cost - Item carbon (with module split): 
- Cost Element cost 
- Cost Element carbon 
- Section cost 
- Section carbon (with module split)

A Project User producing a forecast for an Operation and Maintenance project can input actual Item quantities and Item costs in 
dedicated "actual" columns for each past month/year in the forecast's assessment period.

In an O&M forecast, the data in the "planned" and "actual" columns can be reported to show planned vs. actual totals by month/year and position on screen and in reports.

1850.description: As an estimating manager, I want Project Users to submit interim forecasts for each of the estimates types set out in Scope Table A in a consistent way, similar to the Forecast approach on MP estimates. I want Project Users to input a forecast that follows the structure of NH estimate (for each of the estimate types set out in Scope Table A) at an appropriate level of the WBS, so that valid comparison reports can be produced at an appropriate level of the WBS.
1850.acceptanceCriteria:
Estimators can create Interim forecast Templates(Forecasts) for cost and carbon at section, segment, cost element, item and resource level in CCET for each estimate type in Scope Table A consistent to the forecast approach in MP IFT to allow Project Users to produce an interim forecast revision/revisions. The IFT versions can be used to provide change analysis between baseline estimate and interim forecast versions or between interim forecast versions.
The IFT forecast build in CCET is comprehensive and includes for each and all estimate type in Scope Table A and is consistent with a build which is a replica of base estimate.

The work breakdown structure of forecasts aligns with the configured WBS for each Estimate Type so that NH Estimates and Project Users' forecasts have like-for-like comparison of cost and carbon estimates by WBS.

1861.description: As an estimating manager, I want to be able to enter estimate specific reviewers and approvers for an estimate, but also control the final approver of an estimate (e.g. through an administrator setting) so that this is limited to staff of appropriate authority to authorize the estimate for issue.
1861.acceptanceCriteria:
• As an Estimating Manager / Estimating Administrator with relevant permission, I can assign reviewers so that estimates initiated from approved requests are reviewed by relevant users.
• As an Estimating Administrator, I can set up and manage the list of final approvers for an estimate so that only the relevant users have the authority to provide final approval.

1870.description: "As an estimating manager, I want to be able to tag a single, fully approved estimate to identify it as the "Reference Estimate" for that MP, M&R or AR scheme. This will be the estimate that is carried forward for data and reports at programme and portfolio level and is tagged as the ""Reference Estimate"" against which comparisons can be made. The ""Reference Estimate"" data for cost and carbon are to be from the estimate. Similarly, for Project Users interim forecasting functionality, a ""Preferred Revision"" is to be identified for each scheme where there is a interim forecast. "
1870.acceptanceCriteria:
• A user can generate a comparison report of any estimate for a scheme vs another estimate for the same scheme, on screen in the software
• The estimate being compared against will be identified as the ‘reference estimate’ for the specific comparison for the scheme
• The estimate(s) compared against the ‘reference estimate’ will be identified as the ‘comparator estimate(s)’ for the specific comparison
• A user can generate a report for a scheme with multiple ‘comparator estimate(s)’ but only one ‘reference estimate’
• An estimate for each scheme in a programme can be tagged as the ‘reference estimate’ to create a reference estimate for the programme
• An estimate for each of the schemes in the programme can be tagged as the ‘comparator estimate’ to create a comparator estimate for the programme
• Reference and comparator estimates for programmes can be aggregated to provide portfolio reference and comparator estimates
• A Project User can tag a submitted forecast to NH as the ‘Preferred Forecast’ for a scheme, which can be used to generate reports for the scheme
• and aggregated preferred forecasts at programme and portfolio level

1890.description:
As an NH reviewer of interim forecasts / estimates submitted by a Project User, I want to be able to see which carbon emission factors in the submitted interim forecast / estimate in the system are:
- using assured NH library data- using an uploaded EPD or similar supporting evidence / certificate file
- plugged, without supporting evidence 

This is so the reviewer of the carbon estimate can easily identify the quality of data and areas to review.
1890.acceptanceCriteria:
The NH reviewer of a submitted forecast can generate a report of the carbon estimate that identifies the basis of the carbon emission data for each resource as follows:
- carbon emissions factor from assigned carbon resource library 
- cost-to-carbon factor from assigned carbon resource library
- Resource delinked from resource 
- Plugged carbon factors - source evidence / EPD reference
The NH reviewer of a submitted IFT / forecast (cost and carbon) can see in CCET IFT and generate a report of the carbon estimate forecast in IFT revision that identifies the basis of the carbon emission data for each resource from the Project User Specific library.
Project User Specific Library (PUSL) used by Project user to produce IFT revision / forecast is built in CCET using the following sources.
carbon emissions factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
cost-to-carbon factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Dynamic Library of Low Cabon products.
assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)
unassured carbon emission factor for resources or cost to carbon factors, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)*

The NH reviewer can generate a report showing whether each Resource has ‘assured’ or ‘unassured’ carbon emission factors.

* see terminology amendments in Annex A

1900.description: As Head of Estimating, I want the terminology in the system to be compliant with recognised cost estimating standards and NH terminology. Before the system is launched, I want a complete review of all fields, screens, reports, templates and models to ensure terminology in the system is correct and consistent with standards.
1900.acceptanceCriteria:
The fixed terminology in the CCET is consistent with recognised standards for lifecycle costing and carbon estimating including: 
- RICS professional guidance, UK Lifecycle costing 
- ICMS: Global Consistency in Presenting Construction Life Cycle Costs and Carbon Emissions 
- PAS 2080 Carbon management in buildings and infrastructure 
- RICS, Whole life carbon assessment for the built environment

1901.description: As Head of Estimating, I want to be able to include NH organisation logos on the system screens, dashboards and reports.
1901.acceptanceCriteria: The NH logo is shown on every principal screen, dashboard and report of the CCET.

1910.description: The system is to allow estimate reviewers and approvers to be configured for all estimates (note carbon reviewers and approvers may be different staff than cost estimates).
1910.acceptanceCriteria: • As an Estimating Manager / Estimating Administrator with relevant permission, I can assign multiple reviewers so cost and carbon specifics of the estimate can be reviewed separately by the right reviewers.

1920.description: As and Estimating Manager, I want to see easily which schemes and interim forecasts are assigned to each Project User. I also want to be able to see a live view of when Forecasts have been updated.
1920.acceptanceCriteria:
An NH Estimator with permissions to access all projects (e.g. an Estimating Manager) can view a comprehensive ‘IFT revision / Forecast Browser' that shows the following data: 
- Forecast Project names and other details
- Number of IFT revisions / Forecasts 
- User to which Forecast is assigned 
- Linked NH Estimate 
- NH Estimator Reviewer 
- Current IFT/ Forecast Status 
- Current IFT/ Forecast Due Date 
- Current IFT/ Forecast Submission Date

1930.description: Estimate submissions need to be time stamped.
1930.acceptanceCriteria: • As a CCET user, I can view timestamps on estimates so that I know when the estimate was submitted for review.

1950.description: As an Estimator, I want to be able to compare an IFT with a "Preferred Revision" and the last approved estimate / "Reference Estimate". I want the comparison to be similar to the CERT file "Presentation Data" worksheet, with a free text field to record changes from the last submission.
1950.acceptanceCriteria:
• A user can generate a comparison report of any IFT “Preferred Revision” submitted by a Project User for a scheme vs the last approved NH estimate / “Reference Estimate” for that scheme
• A user can generate a comparison report of any IFT Preferred Revision forecast submitted by a Project User for a scheme vs the NH estimate tagged as a ‘reference estimate’ for that specific comparison
• Costs/Carbon can will be compared at Section, cost element, resource level, on screen in the software
• Free-text fields can be populated at Project level to provide explanation of the delta between the forecast and estimate
• The comparison report can be exported to PDF and Excel format, Including the comments on explanation of the delta between the forecast and estimate

1960.description: See FR 1920 - Identify which projects have submitted an Forecast

1970.description: See 1860 and additional FR entered under that FR. Need to be able to see by who and when each individual estimate has been reviewed / approved. This will allow an Estimating manager to review progress and status of the estimate.
1970.acceptanceCriteria:
• As a CCET user, I can view the status of estimate requests and estimate reviews so that I can track the progress of estimates.
• As a CCET user, I can view the name of each reviewer and approver who has approved an estimate with the date of each approval.

1980.description: As a system user, I want to be able to quickly see just the approved estimates within the "Estimate Browser" so I can quickly select and open the approved estimate for a scheme.
1980.acceptanceCriteria:
• As a CCET user, I can filter estimates by status in the Estimate Browser so that I can find approved estimates quickly.
• As a CCET user, I can select which fields/columns are displayed in the Estimate Browser so that I can use the screen space to view relevant data.
• As a CCET user, I can open any estimate available/accessible to me in the Estimate Browser so that I can see the estimate details.

1981.description: As a user, I want to have a comprehensive "landing page" when opening the system, which contains links to all parts of the system functionality in one place, e.g. components and process flows for producing estimates, scenario analysis, accessing PowerBI reports, etc.
1981.acceptanceCriteria: There is a dedicated “tile” menu item for “Scenario Analysis” on the CCET landing page.

1990.description: As a reviewer of an Interim Forecast submission, I should have the ability in the software to approve or reject an Forecast revision, and record the reasons for rejection / comments so that these can be communicated to the submitter.
1990.acceptanceCriteria:
The NH Reviewer of a submitted forecast can approve or reject the IFT revision submission. This status is visible to the Project User assigned to the IFT revision / forecast in the 'Forecast Browser'.

The NH Reviewer of a submitted IFT revision / forecast can record review comments that summarise the reasons for approval or rejection of the IFT revision / forecast submission. These comments are visible to the Project User assigned to the IFT revision / forecast.

The submission of IFT revision / forecast submission of a forecast and Reviewer's approval / rejection are time and date stamped.

2000.description: As an Estimating Manager, I want to be able to see easily a progress tag and reports for the progress of all estimates that are in production. This should be consistent with workflow milestones across all estimate types.
2000.acceptanceCriteria:
• As a CCET user, I can view reports / dashboards by estimate status so that I can track the progress of estimates across estimate workflow milestones.
• As a CCET user, I can see the status of each estimate in the estimate browser

2010.description: Ability to apply the existing library resources and cost to carbon factors in a quick and efficient way
2010.acceptanceCriteria: The cost-to-carbon factors are stored for specified Resource Groups.

2020.description: This feature is already available, the contractor will then load an EPD, and once the authority validates the new resource carbon value, the updated resource will become available in the Dynamic Carbon Library
2020.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains a Dynamic Carbon Library of carbon emission factors for NH-assured low carbon products supported by evidence such like EPDs or similar documentation.

2030.description: Ability to load into a specific estimate WBS level a full bill of quantities containing Cost and Carbon resource build-ups (i.e. an enhanced Load Spreadsheet feature)
2030.acceptanceCriteria:
As per existing BES functionality, a full Resource build up for each Item in a BoQ can be uploaded to an estimate in the CCET. The following resource data is uploaded in this case: 
- Resource Code 
- Resource Description 
- Resource Quantity 
- Resource Unit 
- Resource Rate (if populated)

2040.description: Ability to ensure that the external data being used is the current data
2040.acceptanceCriteria:
The CCET libraries of cost and carbon resource rates / carbon emission factors include audit trail records of the following for each resource: 
- Source data reference (e.g. hyperlink to external data source) 
- Date of last update 
- Evidence source
These records can be used to check whether library data matches the current external data.

2050.description: Ability to set the Base Carbon library date for 2020 for cost to carbon factors. When a user enters cost to carbon factors, the library must calculate off the 2020 date (otherwise inflation will skew the carbon numbers)
2050.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains a Baseline Carbon Library of carbon emission factors for Resources at a specified base date.

2060.description: Ability to display an estimate-specific Resource Library, with cost and carbon factors
2060.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains an estimate-specific dataset of the Resources in a specific estimate and their cost and carbon rates.

2070.description: Ability to bulk upload of assured carbon factors, cost to carbon factors and EPDs to project-specific library and Dynamic Carbon Library
2070.acceptanceCriteria: An Administrator can upload Dynamic Carbon Library carbon factors and supporting data in bulk using an Excel template to upload the data efficiently.

2080.description: An efficient process to add resources to the Project specific library - if a resource is not available within the library and the contractor requires a new resource, the request will be sent through to NH as a new resource request to be update in the WBS e.g. Bulk Upload functionality
2080.acceptanceCriteria: A CCET user can request National Highways add project-specific Resources in bulk to a library for use in estimates by populating a template and issuing this request to a National Highways Administrator.

2090.description: Bulk approve EPD / emission factors for Resources within the dynamic library
2090.acceptanceCriteria: A National Highways Administrator receives a request from CCET users to add Resources, carbon emission factors and supporting data to the Dynamic Carbon Library in the CCET library and can select Resources from the list that are approved and are added to the library.

2100.description: Develop a controlled process to migrate / re-use Carbon emission factors for resources / items from one library to another
2100.acceptanceCriteria: Carbon Emission Factors can be transferred from one Carbon Resource Library to another by an Administrator.

2110.description: Library to record decarbonisation factors per year, till 2050 (TBC, depending on definition of process)
2110.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET stores decarbonisation factors for each year from 2020 to 2050 in a dedicated library.

2120.description: Maintain internal (assumed) Resource Library to derive carbon data (this must be separate from the Item Cost driven by the regionalised, contractual Item rate)
2120.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET stores multiple Resource libraries.

2130.description: Search across all the EPDs in the Dynamic Library for best cost and carbon to make the optimal decision
2130.acceptanceCriteria: A CCET user with access to the Dynamic Library can search for Resources, carbon emission factors and supporting data using key words, Resource categories, Resource Groups and other data fields in the Dynamic Carbon Library.

2140.description: Set up validation checks for EPDs
2140.acceptanceCriteria:
When an EPD is uploaded as the supporting evidence of a carbon emission factor for a resource, the following data fields are stored to record the validation of the EPD data for that resource: 
- EPD Validation Date 
- Reviewer 
- Data Source 
- Notes / Limitations 
- Next review date

2150.description: Establish a precedence process automatically using a stored Cost to Carbon factor when no carbon emission factor is found
2150.acceptanceCriteria: When the estimator selects a Resource carbon library to apply to an estimate, that library will assign carbon emission factors to each resource in the estimate that has a matching resource description in the library.

2160.description: Software to be configured to allow production of star items by area/regions per asset class with an identifier by supplier name and be available to be used on future estimates by applying automatically library or bottom up estimating. These star items should be made available from one region/area to other nationally.
2160.acceptanceCriteria: An Estimator can create an Item in an estimate using Resources from the relevant Resource library for that estimate, Item, Region and supplier.

2170.description: Dedicated Cost and Carbon Resource Library
2170.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains dedicated Resource cost and carbon Libraries for each lifecycle costing stage

2180.description: Dedicated Item Library with Regionalised rates per Area, Contractor and with Uplifts plus Fees
2180.acceptanceCriteria: The Resource rates held in libraries, and Item rates resulting from the sum of Resources' costs, can vary by the Region

2190.description: Flag existing Items as Star Items
2190.acceptanceCriteria: Items in an Estimate can be tagged as "Star Rates", i.e. not part of an original set of Items for a supplier /  contract.

2200.description: Item Library for MR (with Regionalised rates per Area and Contractor)
2200.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET has dedicated Item and Resource Libraries of cost rates for the Operation and Maintenance lifecycle costing stages.

2210.description: Need an efficient process to add resources to the baseline library
2210.acceptanceCriteria: An Administrator can upload Resources, their carbon factors and supporting data to the Baseline Carbon Library in bulk using an Excel template to upload the data efficiently.

2220.description: Regionalised Library - Rates are awarded at a region (Item level)
2220.acceptanceCriteria: The Resource rates held in libraries, and Item rates resulting from the sum of Resources' costs, can vary by the Region

2230.description: Resource Library setup for Asset Renewal Estimates
2230.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET can store dedicated Resource Libraries for the Asset Renewal lifecycle stage.

2240.description: Ability for the project manager to review and approve and estimate, without a requirement for a separate license
2240.acceptanceCriteria: Where a designated Reviewer of an NH Estimate does not hold a CCET licence, the Estimator can select an option to send a time-limited hyperlink to that designated reviewer when the Estimate is ready for review.

2250.description: Ability to approve or reject a Contractor's estimate and provide comments and feedback on the rejection
2250.acceptanceCriteria: The NH Reviewer of an IFT revision / submitted forecast can approve or reject the submission. This is visible to the Project User assigned to the IFT revision /forecast.

2260.description: Ability to update the name of the delegated reviewer and provide digital approval
2260.acceptanceCriteria: An Estimating Manager can edit the name of an Estimate Reviewer at any time during production of the estimate until the estimate is approved and status changed to ‘Authorised’.

2270.description: Assign approvers and reviewers to an estimate (cost and carbon).
2270.acceptanceCriteria:
• As an Estimating Manager / Estimating Administrator with relevant permission, I can assign multiple reviewers so cost and carbon specifics of the estimate can be reviewed separately by the right reviewers.
• As an Estimating Administrator, I can setup and maintain the list of users authorised to approve estimates so that estimators can assign estimates to authorised users only for approval.

2280.acceptanceCriteria:
• Software generates release forms (CE300) automatically on estimate approval.
• CE300 form will be specific to the lifecycle stage - New Construction, M&R, AR.
• CE300 forms can be exported to PDF.
• See FRs 210, 170 and any other related to this FR.

2290.description: Need separate Cost and Carbon sign offs (CE300 forms)
2290.acceptanceCriteria:
• Software generates a separate Carbon estimate approval form (Carbon CE300) automatically on estimate approval for estimates types included in FR10.
• Carbon CE300 form will be specific to estimates types included in FR10 and to the lifecycle stage - New Construction, M&R, AR.
• Carbon CE300 form will contain only Carbon data from the estimate, not Cost.
• Carbon CE300 form can include images, graphs and tables.
• Carbon CE300 form can be exported to PDF.

2300.description: On the approval form, a user would be required to assign approvers, e.g. Approver 1,2,3 and the associated user. Except for PM's
2300.acceptanceCriteria:
• As an Estimating Administrator, I can set up and manage the list of final approvers for an estimate so that only the relevant users have the authority to provide final approval.
• As an CCET user / Estimator, I can assign an estimate to an authorised approver so that the estimate can be approved after it passes all the required reviews.

2310.description: Record the role and name of the estimate reviewer and approver.
2310.acceptanceCriteria:
• As a CCET user, I can see the status of estimate reviews in the Estimate Browser so that I can track my estimates.
• As a CCET user, I can see the reviewers / approvers assigned to an estimate so that I have the required information.

2320.description: A contractor will required to mark the "Contractor" estimate as "ready for review"
2320.acceptanceCriteria: When a Project User submits an IFT revision / forecast for NH review, the status of the IFT revision / forecast is updated to "Under Review" or similar term. This status is visible in the 'Forecast Browser'.

2330.description: Ability to approve and timestamp the approval of the estimate. Project managers will not have access to system and will still need to approve the estimate.
2330.acceptanceCriteria: Estimate Reviewers will click a command button to complete a Review of the Estimate.

2340.description: Contractor should be able to add comments to the "Rejected" estimate, so when they re-submit the estimate in the software they can specify how they have rectified the estimate. Contractor should be able to add comments to the "Rejected" estimate, so when they re-submit the estimate in the software they can specify how they have rectified the estimate.
2340.acceptanceCriteria: When a Project User submits a revised rejected IFT revision / forecast for NH review, the Project User can enter comments to explain the revised IFT revision / forecast submission, including details of actions taken to rectify previously rejected submissions. These comments are visible to the NH Reviewer and Project User.

2350.description: Estimating managers should be able to see a summary description alongside previous v/s proposed estimate comparisons to explain the cost movement for each cost heading and this data needs to be stored.
2350.acceptanceCriteria:
• As a CCET user, I can generate a summary estimate comparison report of a selected estimate versus the last approved estimate for that project
• As a CCET user, I can enter Comments to estimates Cost element level available to me so that I can provide more information such as summary descriptions.
• As a CCET user, I can view estimate comments at Cost element level in a Comparator interface so that I can view and compare explanations for cost / carbon movements.

2360.description: Reviewers should be able to assign and record the analytical assurance rating for the estimate. This will include the ability to review the plugged-in items.
2360.acceptanceCriteria: The Estimator can upload an Analytical Assurance Statement to the Estimate Documents Folder. (Note the Analytical Assurance Statement is produced outside the software.)

2370.description: Ability to compare the estimated cost with the outturn cost data for similar schemes at a section and cost element level. This is to ensure greater cost accuracy.
2370.acceptanceCriteria: Actual outturn costs for a project are entered to the CCET in a designated estimate, classified as an 'Actual Outturn Cost' or similar (configurable estimate classification).

2380.description: Distinguish between Resources with carbon factors coming from the Base Carbon Library and those with carbon factors plugged in by the Contractor but not yet assured
2380.acceptanceCriteria:
The NH reviewer of a submitted forecast can generate a report of the carbon estimate that identifies the basis of the carbon emission data for each resource as follows:
- carbon emissions factor from assigned carbon resource library 
- cost-to-carbon factor from assigned carbon resource library
- Resource delinked from resource 
- Plugged carbon factors 
- source evidence / EPD reference

The NH reviewer of a submitted IFT / forecast (cost and carbon) can see in CCET IFT and generate a report of the carbon estimate forecast in IFT revision that identifies the basis of the carbon emission data for each resource from the Project User Specific library.
Project User Specific Library (PUSL) used by Project user to produce IFT revision / forecast is built in CCET using the following sources.
carbon emissions factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
cost-to-carbon factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Dynamic Library of Low Cabon products.
assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)
unassured carbon emission factor for resources or cost to carbon factors, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)

The NH reviewer can generate a report showing whether each Resource has ‘assured’ or ‘unassured’ carbon emission factors.
[Please see terminology amendments in Annex A]

2390.description: Estimate Reviewers should see the provenance of the carbon factors against each resource in the BOQ. This is so that the reviewer can identify carbon factors from library, cost to carbon factors, and manually entered factors.
2390.acceptanceCriteria: When in a CCET carbon estimate, the NH Estimator, Estimating Managers and Administrators can see the carbon library used to produce the estimated carbon for each Item in a BoQ. Where cost-to-carbon factors and / or manually entered emission factors have been used in the build-up of estimated carbon for an Item, the report will identify the Items where "cost-to-carbon factors" and Items where rates have been "delinked" from a carbon library.

2400.description: Library of common metrics specific to scheme type and characteristics that enable the user to review the estimate v/s the metrics
2400.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET contains an administrator-controlled library of configurable metrics holding benchmark values for each metric that are entered by the administrator.

2410.description: Record the required data/evidence that a contractor submits to add resources and emission factors to the library
2410.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET Resource libraries contain dedicated fields to store supporting evidence and audit trail data for each Resource  within the library, it's cost rate and carbon emissions factor.

2420.description: View additional evidence to see an audit trail on key carbon emissions
2420.acceptanceCriteria: The CCET Resource libraries contain dedicated fields to store supporting evidence and audit trail data for each Resource  within the library, it's cost rate and carbon emissions factor.

2430.description: View compliance against a set of data quality requirements and evidence, submitted with contractor's estimate
2430.acceptanceCriteria:
The NH reviewer of a submitted IFT revision / forecast can see on screen and generate a report of the carbon estimate that identifies the basis of the carbon emission data for each resource as follows:
- carbon emissions factor from assigned carbon resource library 
- cost-to-carbon factor from assigned carbon resource library
- Resource delinked from resource 
- Plugged carbon factors 
- source evidence / EPD reference
• carbon emissions factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
• cost-to-carbon factor from NH baseline CCET carbon resource library
• assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Dynamic Library of Low Cabon products.
• assured carbon emission factor for resources including the EPD, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)
• unassured carbon emission factor for resources or cost to carbon factors, from Project User Specific Library (PUSL)

The NH reviewer can generate a report showing whether each Resource has ‘assured’ or ‘unassured’ carbon emission factors.
[Please see terminology amendments in Annex A]

2440.description: Ability to control if Section-level Cost data from a baseline Estimate assigned to a Contractor is visible to the Contractor
2440.acceptanceCriteria: An administrator can control the level of cost data from NH estimates that is visible as a baseline for supplier forecasts in the CCET. The administrator sets this control across the CCET in a table within the administration settings.

2450.description: Access Controls to lock the WBS of the carbon estimate down to cost element level
2450.acceptanceCriteria: The WBS, Items and Item quantities of a NH carbon estimate are identical to that of the corresponding NH cost estimate.

2460.description: Contractors should only be able to view Section level costs in the baseline. This is so that the Authority sectional costs act as a working sectional budget for the contractor to work towards.
2460.acceptanceCriteria:
An administrator can control the level of cost data from NH estimates that is visible as a baseline for supplier forecasts in the CCET. The administrator sets this control across the CCET in a table within the administration settings.

The administrator can select one of the following whether forecast baselines' rate and cost columns are visible at the following levels: 
- None (no baseline cost data is visible to Project Users) 
- Project (only baseline Project cost totals are visible to Project Users) 
- Section (only baseline Section and Project cost totals are visible to Project Users) 
- Item (baseline Item rates, Item costs, Section and Project cost totals are visible to Project Users) 
- Resource (all rates and costs in the baseline are visible to Project Users)

2470.description: Mandate the selection of resources that the contractor can use to the resources currently available in the Libraries (WBS) - they will need to link any changes to the EPD to get approval.
2470.acceptanceCriteria:
A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add resources to an estimate by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding resources only from the assigned CCET NH Resource Library. This setting can be applied to all IFT templates in CCET and a specific Project.

“A CCET administrator can disable the ability for a Project User to add Resources to a forecast by manual entry and load spreadsheet, i.e. restrict Project Users to adding Resources only from the NH CCET Resource Library, where a Project User’s only access to a Resource Library is to the NH CCET Resource Library .”
The CCET Project-Specific resource libraries contain an EPD or link to reference EPD data. When a Project User requests changes to the project-specific library (business process outside the CCET) they can provide EPD data to justify the change.

CCET IFT/forecast allows Project Users to add EPD data(link or PDF) to the resources in the Project User Specific library. This entry is marked as unassured. Once NH assures this resource and EPD data the resource is marked as assured. Communication and assurance process for EPD data in CCET project user specific library is business process that happens outside CCET.

2480.description: Provide controls around the cost data that the contractor can see when selecting a client estimate. The contractor will be assigned the estimate and only see the estimates that are assigned to them.
2480.acceptanceCriteria: An administrator can control the level of cost data from NH estimates that is visible as a baseline for supplier forecasts in the CCET. The administrator sets this control across the CCET in a table within the administration settings.

2490.description: Ability to lock down an Forecast Revision from further changes, unless approved by admin
2490.acceptanceCriteria:
Once an IFT revision / forecast is submitted for review, the forecast is locked and cannot be edited.

Only an Administrator can change the status of an approved, locked IFT revision / forecast so that it can be edited.
